title: Do TikTok Ads Work? A Data-Backed Guide to ROI and Strategy
summary: Discover if TikTok ads actually work. We analyze real ROI data, compare ad formats, and show you how to use TikTok Ads Manager to run profitable campaigns.
body_markdown:
## How to Use TikTok Ads Manager: Login, Setup, and Campaign Launch


TikTok Ads Manager is the control center for building campaigns, choosing audiences, setting budgets, and reviewing results. Prepare your business details, payment method, website or shop destination, and video assets before starting. Set up conversion tracking so you can judge performance and make informed changes.


### TikTok Ads Manager Login and Account Creation (Step-by-Step)


To create an account, visit TikTok Ads Manager and register with a business email or an available TikTok account option. If you already have an account, use the tiktok ads manager login page and confirm that you are signing in to the correct business account. Complete the requested business and billing details, select your account’s country or region and time zone, then review the setup information before submitting. These choices can affect reporting and account administration.


After access is active, connect the assets needed for your campaign. Add your website or select the relevant shop destination, set up TikTok Pixel or Events API if you need website conversion measurement, and verify that key events register correctly. Limit login access to authorized team members, with permissions matched to each person’s role. A clean account structure makes campaign reporting easier to manage.


### How to Create a TikTok Ads Campaign: Campaign, Ad Group, and Ad Levels


Campaigns have three levels, each controlling a different decision. First, choose an objective that matches the outcome you want, such as traffic, lead generation, or sales. Next, create an ad group to set placements, audience, schedule, optimization event, and budget. At the ad level, upload the video, write the caption, choose a call to action, and confirm the destination URL. This structure keeps audience settings and creative decisions organized.


Before publishing, check that the destination loads on mobile, the offer matches the ad, and conversion events are firing. Give each campaign a clear name that identifies its objective and test. If you are learning how to create tiktok ads, start with one objective, a defined audience hypothesis, and a small set of creative variations. Review delivery and conversion data before making changes.


### Choosing the Right TikTok Ad Format: In-Feed, Spark, TopView, and More


Choose a format based on the ad’s role. In-Feed ads appear within the For You feed and suit discovery or direct response. Spark Ads promote eligible organic TikTok posts while retaining the post’s social context. TopView appears prominently when users open the app, making it a high-visibility placement. Availability, buying method, and campaign requirements can vary, so confirm current options in your account.


Format Placement or source Consider it for


In-Feed For You feed Product discovery and direct-response tests


Spark Ads Eligible organic posts Promoting existing TikTok content


TopView Prominent app-open placement Broad visibility for a major campaign


### Targeting Options That Drive Conversions


Build an audience from your strongest signals, and avoid narrowing it without a clear reason. Ads Manager offers options such as location, age, language, interests, and behaviors, along with custom audiences and audience exclusions where available. Define the customer and geographic market first. Use retargeting for people who have visited or engaged, provided audience size and privacy settings support it.


Review audience delivery alongside cost per result, click-through rate, and conversion events. If impressions are limited, loosen unnecessary restrictions; if clicks arrive without purchases, check the offer, landing page, and tracking before changing audience settings. Tie each optimization to evidence as you learn how to use tiktok ads manager.
